incidents_and_corrections.summary: Earlier worker/invalidation tests patched settings.__dict__['database_url'], which has no effect because database_url is a property. Those runs targeted the default localhost:5432/eims_registry configuration.
incidents_and_corrections.containment: One synthetic probe table (r1_invalidate_probe, 0 rows) had been created in eims_registry; it was dropped and absence verified. No business data read or changed.
incidents_and_corrections.correction: Tests now patch DB_* fields, assert DB_NAME and current_database() == eims_incident_test, and were re-run. All R-1 results in this manifest are from the corrected runs.

why_not_accepted: Security Acceptance is not granted: Gateway authorization, Journal hardening, Benchmark mutation safety, maintenance CLI and seed/clear_db remain excluded and unverified; no evidence that they are disabled or restricted in a deployable configuration.
Live deployment verification has not been performed; EIMS_DB_IDENTITY / EIMS_DB_IDENTITY_REQUIRED=1 are prepared but not applied to any environment.
Least-privilege DB role provisioning (non-owner, INSERT/SELECT only, no trigger-disable) is a deployment step that has not been executed.
path_to_b: Apply and verify EIMS_DB_IDENTITY + EIMS_DB_IDENTITY_REQUIRED=1 in the target API and worker configuration.
Provision the runtime DB role as a non-owner with least privilege and no TRIGGER/DDL rights.
Prove excluded subsystems are unreachable/restricted in the deployed topology, or accept them with their own evidence.
Run the identity and verification smoke checks against the live environment and record the results.

raw INSERT of an already-resolved incident

privilege_topology.residual_risk: A fully compromised runtime credential can INSERT an internally consistent verification row; the trigger requires incident-bound evidence, matching digest, distinct verifier and current-cycle freshness. True separation needs a verifier credential or SECURITY DEFINER path (out of scope).

verifier_threat_model.condition_to_close: If the deployment threat model includes a compromised application credential, an independent verifier service (or external signing authority held outside the runtime process) is a deployment prerequisite.
verifier_threat_model.security_definer_rejection: Rejected on two independent grounds: (a) it does not reduce threat B because the runtime role is the caller, and (b) a correct implementation requires owner-privilege hygiene (fixed search_path with pg_temp last, PUBLIC EXECUTE revoked in the same transaction, validated inputs) for no gain here.
